sources.title: Ministral-3-14B-Base-2512: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview Ministral-3-14B-Base-2512 is a 14-billion-parameter base pre-trained language model created by mistralai that combines a 13.5B language model with a 0.4B vision encoder for multimodal capabilities. The model supports a 256k context window, operates with BF16 precision, and runs on vLLM or transformers frameworks. Built for edge deployment, it fits in 32GB of VRAM in BF16 format and ...

sources.title: Ministral 3 14B - docs.mistral.ai
sources.snippet: Ministral 3 14B is the largest model in the Ministral 3 family, offering state-of-the-art capabilities and performance comparable to its larger Mistral Small 3.2 24B counterpart. Optimized for local deployment, it delivers high performance across diverse hardware, including local setups.
